name: Rendezvous at Yunqiu Mountain
overview: When strong-willed heiress Lin Jing and gentle inn employee Su Xiaomeng magically switch lives, they’re thrust into each other’s challenges. Lin Jing uses her sharp instincts to transform the struggling inn, while Su Xiaomeng brings warmth and sincerity to revive the Lvye Group. As their unexpected journeys unfold, both women begin to confront their pasts, open themselves to new possibilities, and discover where their true paths may lead.
